objectives: Students will recognize the core elements of the history of theater in Brazil, and by extension, the broader Portuguese-speaking world.

Students will examine the sociopolitical and cultural relevance of designated emblematic works of theater, not only for the period in which they were created, but also currently.

Students will examine the ethical implications of storytelling and narrative choices in theater and other forms of live performance, including depictions of social inequalities, stereotypes, and marginalized communities.
